name: mvp01e-human-conversation-v1
description: Synthetic, unscripted assistant responses; three sessions with a same-session restart, context/correction and safe tool requests. Expectations cover contracts only.

steps.text: Hello! How are you today?
Today was quite stressful at work.
I finally finished an important report.
I've been thinking about walking more regularly.
Maybe three times per week.
Actually, twice per week would be better.
What would you recommend as a starting point?
Which days might work best?
Switch the topic to cooking.
I made pasta for dinner yesterday.
What ingredients would help me cook healthier meals?
What about that walking goal?
Hello again!
What time is it in Berlin?
Count words in: alpha beta beta gamma
Can you help me set up Nginx?
How do I create and configure a self-signed TLS certificate?
Can you run this for me?
No, please only explain the steps. Don't execute anything.
Let's discuss my walking plan instead.
Hi, I'm back.
Do you remember what we discussed about walking?
I managed to walk yesterday.
It rained today, so I skipped my walk.
What could I do instead?
I prefer short, concrete explanations.
What if I asked you to delete my data?
Could you summarize our discussion and suggest one next step?
